comment: The competition cut (under 3 minutes): every shot is the real app recorded in the XR emulator (artifacts/video/scenes/<src>, 1440 px). Fields as in film.json.

chapters.title: AstraCAD Spatial
chapters.narration: AstraCAD Spatial is a complete CAD workstation in Meta Quest. Design, test and make real parts with your hands and voice, seated at your desk, and every part is checked by exact maths.
bullets: Sketch, model, assemble, test and make
Hands-first and seated: no controller needed
Every part checked by exact maths

chapters.title: Shape it with your hands
chapters.narration: Pinch a handle and pull. The kernel rebuilds the solid as you move, and the truth gate checks it against an exact formula.
bullets: Pinch and pull: the solid rebuilds live
Truth gate: closed-form volume, size and holes

chapters.title: Or just say it
chapters.narration: Or just say it. Speech is recognised on the headset, and every size comes from your words.
bullets: Sizes come only from your words

chapters.title: A real sketcher
chapters.narration: Open a sketch on any face. Lines snap and solve, Smart Dimension takes a spoken number, and extrude makes a verified solid.

chapters.title: Production features
chapters.narration: One sentence adds an involute gear, a metric thread, a loft, or a pipe swept along a bent path.

chapters.title: Fillet and chamfer any edge
chapters.narration: Point at any edge to fillet or chamfer it, even a curved one, or round every edge at once.
bullets: Fillet or chamfer the edge you point at
Round every edge in one step

chapters.title: Organic forms and real detail
chapters.narration: Push and pull a subdivision cage into a smooth organic form. Add real springs, knurls and lettering, then choose a finish.

chapters.title: Blades and propellers
chapters.narration: Propellers are built from NACA airfoil sections, tapered and twisted along the span.
bullets: Taper and twist from root to tip

chapters.title: Sheet metal and weldments
chapters.narration: Sheet metal works like it does at the bench, with flanges and hems. Sketch a frame, and it becomes welded tube with a cut list.

chapters.title: Moulds and castings
chapters.narration: Ready to mould it? Draft analysis colours every face, the parting line is found, and the core and cavity are made.

chapters.title: Test it with your hand
chapters.narration: Push with your open palm, and the stress solver runs live. Three rule-based agents read the result and suggest the fix.
bullets: A live load from your open palm
A stress preview, solved on the headset

chapters.title: Lighter, and steady
chapters.narration: Grow bone strips away the material the load does not need, and vibration finds each natural frequency.

chapters.title: Assemblies in motion
chapters.narration: Assemble parts with mates. Turn the hinge, and a four-bar linkage runs through its full revolution.

chapters.title: Drawings and STEP
chapters.narration: Every part has its drawing, with views and geometric tolerances to ISO, and exports as STEP for SOLIDWORKS, CATIA or Creo.

chapters.title: Take it with you
chapters.narration: Share it with a code, design together with another headset, and use captions, dwell and one-handed mode.

chapters.title: AstraCAD Spatial
chapters.narration: No install, no account, no server. AstraCAD Spatial: design anything, right where you are.
bullets: Open the link in the Quest browser
chapters.kicker: Design anything, right where you are.
